about.not.1: Does not diagnose, interpret lab values, or give medical advice.
about.not.2: Does not tell you whether you qualify, what to file, or what will happen to your case.
about.not.3: Does not draft, fill or format any official form or letter.
about.not.4: Does not invent phone numbers, websites, addresses or organization names. Contacts come only from your paper or from the vetted resource list.
about.not.5: Does not compute dates from memory. A date comes only from a phrase printed on the paper plus a cited rule, and is always labelled as an estimate.
about.not.6: Does not store your papers on any server, does not log their content, and never asks your immigration status.
about.not.7: Does not send real papers to the AI on unpaid keys. The server refuses and offers sample papers instead.

fixed.address_change_multi_agency: If you move, the court needs its own address form (EOIR-33). USPS forwarding does not update the court or USCIS.
fixed.asylum_fee_notice: There is no fee waiver for this fee.
fixed.conditional_card: A 2-year Green Card cannot be renewed with Form I-90. Ask a lawyer or DOJ-accredited representative what to file well before it expires.
fixed.court_date_is_the_deadline: The court date on this paper is the date that matters. If you miss it, the judge can decide your case without you. Go, even if you do not have a lawyer yet.
fixed.eob_not_a_bill: This is not a bill. Do not pay from this paper. Wait for the bill from the doctor or hospital, then compare the two.
fixed.eviction_summons: The court date on this paper is the date that matters. Go, or you can lose automatically.
fixed.jury_summons: You must answer this form. If you are not a U.S. citizen, mark 'not a citizen' and send it back. Never check 'citizen' and never register to vote — it can permanently harm your immigration case.
fixed.multiple_documents: These pages look like two different papers. I explained the first one. Scan the other one on its own.
fixed.notario_not_a_lawyer: A notario is not a lawyer in the United States. Only a licensed lawyer or a DOJ-accredited representative can give legal advice. You can check a helper's name on the government list.
fixed.pay_or_quit: This is not a court order. Only a court can make you leave.
fixed.traffic_court_immigration: If you are not a U.S. citizen, talk to an immigration lawyer before you pay or plead guilty. Some tickets and court cases can affect an immigration case.
fixed.uscis_receipt_i765: A receipt for a work-permit renewal filed on or after October 30, 2025 is not proof you can work. Ask a lawyer or DOJ-accredited representative about a possible work gap.

privacy.notice.delete: You can delete one paper, one family member's papers, or everything, any time.
privacy.notice.device: Papers you choose to save stay on this phone, protected by your phone's own encryption. Turn on a phone passcode.
privacy.notice.device_web: In this browser, papers are kept only while the tab is open, unless you turn on 'Keep on this device'. The app does not encrypt them.
privacy.notice.feedback: When you tap 'Was this clear?' or 'Report a problem', we count it. We do not receive the text of your paper.
privacy.notice.hide_parts: You can black out parts of a page before it is read.
privacy.notice.install_id: Your phone sends a random code so one phone cannot use the service too much. The code is scrambled and forgotten after 30 days. You can reset it with 'Delete everything'.
privacy.notice.model.local: {model} is an open AI model. The company that made it does not get your paper.
privacy.notice.no_ads: We do not sell your information. There are no ads and no trackers.
privacy.notice.no_status: We never ask about your immigration status. We do not ask for your exact address. Only your state and the first 3 digits of your ZIP code, if you choose to give them.
privacy.notice.sent: When you read a paper, the photo goes to our server and then to Google's AI (Gemini). Our server does not keep it.
privacy.notice.sent.local: When you read a paper, the photo goes to our server. An AI program on our server reads it. Our server does not keep it.
privacy.notice.settings_sent: Your language, your state, your ZIP prefix and your calendar notes (like Ramadan) are sent with each paper so the answer fits you. They are not kept on our server.
privacy.notice.what_we_keep: Our server does not keep your papers or photos. It keeps short technical notes, like the kind of paper and how long it took. It deletes them after 30 days. The notes never hold your paper's words, what you type, or the AI's words.

warn.address_change_multi_agency: USCIS, the immigration court, the BIA and ICE each need their own address form.
warn.ask_for_plain_language_summary: Ask for the plain-language summary of financial assistance in your language.
warn.asylum_rules_aug_2026: Since August 21, 2026, evidence is due 14 days before an asylum interview, and rescheduling needs a strong reason.
warn.court_date_is_the_deadline: The court date on this paper is the date that matters. Go, or you can lose automatically.
warn.ead_receipt_not_work_authorization: A receipt for a work-permit renewal filed on or after October 30, 2025 is not proof you can work.
warn.eeoc_deadline_180_300: Discrimination charges usually must be filed within 180 days (300 in some states).
warn.forms_are_free: USCIS forms and online accounts are always free.
warn.hr1_coverage_changes: Health coverage rules for many immigrants changed in 2026 and 2027. Ask a navigator what applies to you.
warn.jury_never_check_citizen: Never check 'citizen' on a jury form if you are not a U.S. citizen.
warn.jury_never_register_to_vote: Never register to vote unless you are a U.S. citizen. It can permanently harm your immigration case.
warn.law_changes_2027: This law changes again on July 1, 2027. Confirm with the court or a legal helpline.
warn.lsc_eviction_db_2021: This database describes laws as of January 1, 2021. Confirm current rules with a legal helpline.
warn.medicare_windows_changed: Medicare plan appeal windows changed in 2026. Use the date printed on your notice.
warn.no_fee_waiver_hr1: There is no fee waiver for this fee.
warn.not_a_court_order: This is not a court order. Only a court can make you leave.
warn.osha_retaliation_30d: Retaliation complaints to OSHA must be filed within 30 days.
warn.schools_may_not_ask_status: Public schools may not ask about immigration status or require a Social Security number to enroll a child.
warn.tps_dates_from_federal_register: TPS dates come from official notices and change often. Check the country page.
warn.usps_does_not_forward_uscis: The post office does not forward USCIS mail.
warn.verify_local_office_open: Check that the local office is still open before you go. Some offices closed in 2025–2026.
warning.blocked_partial: Part of this paper could not be read safely.
warning.checks_unavailable: Some safety checks do not work in this language yet.
warning.contacts_stripped: A phone number or link was removed because it was not printed on your paper. See Get help nearby.
warning.injection_masked: This paper contained text meant for computers. I ignored it.
warning.low_quality_image: The photo was hard to read. Some words may be wrong.
warning.org_removed_inline: a group or office (see Get help nearby)
warning.page_edge_crop: Part of a page may be cut off. Check the edges.
warning.partial_pages: Some pages could not be read.
warning.translation_partial: Only the important parts were translated. The rest is in the paper's own language.
why.check_service_area: Check that they serve your area
why.for_charity_care: For free or reduced-cost hospital care
why.for_this_paper: Made for this kind of paper
why.for_utility_shutoff: For power, gas or water shutoff notices
wipe.body: This removes all saved papers, members, reminders and settings from this phone. It cannot be undone.
wipe.body.web: This removes all saved papers, members, reminders and settings from this browser. It cannot be undone.
wipe.title: Delete everything on this phone?
